== condition
plan: id=plan type=agent
gate: id=gate type=condition if={{ .Fields.deploy }}
deploy: id=deploy type=command
#end:
== fanout
plan: id=plan type=agent
spread: id=spread type=fan_out
spread.api/api_impl: id=api_impl type=agent
spread.api/api_test: id=api_test type=command
#ref:spread:web: lane=web workflow=web-feature if={{ .Fields.web }}
#merge:spread: on_conflict=agent join=spread resolver=fixup
ship: id=ship type=command
#end:
== guarded
plan: id=plan type=agent check=go build ./...
maybe: id=maybe type=command if={{ eq .Fields.mode "full" }}
ship: id=ship type=command
#end:
== lanedag
plan: id=plan type=agent
spread: id=spread type=fan_out
spread.api/api_work: id=api_work type=agent
spread.db/db_work: id=db_work type=agent
spread.wire/wire_work: id=wire_work type=agent
#merge:spread: on_conflict=block join=spread
ship: id=ship type=command
#end:
== laneshadow
build: id=build type=command
spread: id=spread type=fan_out
spread.api/build: id=build type=command
spread.web/build: id=build type=command
#merge:spread: on_conflict=block join=spread
ship: id=ship type=command
#end:
== loop
plan: id=plan type=agent
repeat: id=repeat type=loop
work: id=work type=agent
verify: id=verify type=command
ship: id=ship type=command
#end:
== loopbreak
plan: id=plan type=agent
repeat: id=repeat type=loop
work: id=work type=agent
enough: id=enough type=break if={{ .Steps.work.Success }}
ship: id=ship type=command
#end:
== nested
repeat: id=repeat type=loop
work: id=work type=agent
skip: id=skip type=condition if={{ .Steps.work.Success }}
record: id=record type=command
spread: id=spread type=fan_out
spread.one/first: id=first type=command
spread.two/second: id=second type=command
#merge:spread: on_conflict=block join=spread
#end:
== parallel
plan: id=plan type=agent
checks: id=checks type=parallel
lint: id=lint type=command
unit: id=unit type=command
e2e: id=e2e type=command if={{ .Fields.slow }}
ship: id=ship type=command
#end:
== sequential
plan: id=plan type=agent
build: id=build type=command
ship: id=ship type=manual
#end:
== wide
wide: id=wide type=agent name=実装をレビューしてからマージする
emoji: id=emoji type=command name=🚀🚀🚀 deploy 🚀🚀🚀 everything everywhere
#end:
